### The Anointing of Saul
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/anointing-of-saul
Passage: 1 Samuel 10:1
Points:
- Samuel anointing Saul with oil confirmed that God established Israel's monarchy despite the people's flawed motives.
- Anointing symbolized the Holy Spirit's empowerment rather than reliance on human strength or worldly models.
- The authority of Israel's king was strictly limited by God's law and the prophet's instruction.
- Jesus Christ fulfilled this ideal perfectly by submitting completely to the Father's will.
- Christian leaders today must similarly operate under God's word and never exceed biblical authority.

### 3 Faith-Strengthening Lessons from Samuel Anointing Saul
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/lessons-from-samuel-anointing-saul.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 10:1-8
Points:
- The fulfillment of Samuel's specific prophetic signs demonstrates that God holds good, ordained plans for our lives.
- Seeking God allows the Holy Spirit to transform our character and equip us for His purposes.
- Samuel's reminder that God was with Saul assures believers that they never walk out their calling alone.
- Through Christ, believers receive God's anointing and daily empowerment to serve Him faithfully.
